entities.name: Mana value
entities.description: A number determined by the total amount of mana in an object's mana cost; formerly called casting cost and converted mana cost.

entities.name: Sixth Edition
entities.description: The release whose rules changes renamed casting cost to converted mana cost.

entities.name: Strixhaven: School of Mages
entities.description: The set that introduced the term mana value.

entities.name: Scourge
entities.description: The set with the Cost matters theme encouraging spells with high mana values.

events.summary: Before Sixth Edition the concept was called casting cost; the Sixth Edition rules changes renamed it converted mana cost.
events.quote: With the Sixth Edition rules changes , "casting cost" became "converted mana cost"

events.summary: The term mana value is introduced in Strixhaven: School of Mages and older cards are updated.
events.quote: The term "mana value" was introduced in Strixhaven: School of Mages .

events.summary: Scourge's Cost matters theme encourages spells with high mana values.
events.quote: "Cost matters" was a theme in Scourge
